name: color-picker
title: Cloudlet Color Picker
description: A round swatch that morphs into a color picker on interruptible springs: a saturation × brightness area, hue and optional opacity sliders, an editable value in hex, rgb, hsl or oklch, an eyedropper where the browser has one, and copy. ColorPickerPanel renders the same panel inline. No dependencies.
docs: Import ColorPicker (or ColorPickerPanel) from components/ui/color-picker/color-picker; it imports its own color-picker.css. color/onChange take any hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch() string and return one in `format` (hex by default); `formats` limits the switch, `alpha` adds opacity, `name` adds a hidden input. Styles read the shadcn tokens --background, --foreground, --border, --ring and --muted. The panel is not portalled: give an `overflow: hidden` ancestor `overflow: visible`.
